g.title: Ren skids to a stop in front of her, out of breath. REN, shouting: Hana! Wait! Sound effect: ZZAK.
Closer. Hana does not turn round. HANA, thinking: Late. Again. REN, quietly: ...sorry.
Ren bows low. Hana looks at him at last. REN, shouting: I ran the whole way! HANA, shouting: You ran the wrong way!
They walk off along the fence together. REN: Same time tomorrow? HANA: Six. Not seven.
